title: Testing Exogeneity in Nonparametric Instrumental Variable Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.01806v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We propose a test of mean exogeneity in nonparametric instrumental variable models. Under completeness, the null is equivalent to a conditional moment restriction involving the ordinary regression function, so the test avoids estimation of the structural function and its ill-posed inverse problem. We construct a residual-marked empirical process and analyze it through an auxiliary U-process of order two. We derive its limiting distributions under the null and Pitman-type local alternatives of order $n^{-1/2}$, and establish consistency against fixed global alternatives. The analysis reveals a nonparametric estimation effect that invalidates a direct multiplier bootstrap. We propose a computationally simple multiplier bootstrap with a tailor-made indicator correction to account for this effect, and establish its asymptotic validity. translated_title: 非参数工具变量模型中的外生性检验
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种针对非参数工具变量模型的均值外生性检验方法。在完备性条件下，原假设等价于一个涉及普通回归函数的条件矩约束，因此该检验避免了对结构函数的估计及其不适定的逆问题。我们构造了一个带残差标记的经验过程，并通过辅助的二阶U-过程对其进行分析。我们推导了该过程在原假设以及阶数为 $n^{-1/2}$ 的Pitman型局部备择假设下的极限分布，并证明了该检验对固定全局备择假设具有一致性。分析揭示了一种非参数估计效应，该效应使得直接的乘子bootstrap方法失效。为此，我们提出了一种计算简单的乘子bootstrap方法，并配以专门设计的示性函数修正来考虑这一效应，同时建立了其渐近有效性。模拟结果表明，在所考虑的非参数设计中，该方法具有良好的显著性水平控制，且功效优于现有方法。
tldr: 本文提出一种非参数工具变量模型的均值外生性检验，通过残差标记经验过程与修正的乘子bootstrap，避免了对结构函数的不适定估计问题，并实现了良好的检验水平和功效。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a mean exogeneity test for nonparametric instrumental variable models that, by using a residual-marked empirical process and a corrected multiplier bootstrap, avoids the ill-posed estimation of structural functions while achieving good size control and power.
